label: Idle maximum: a maximum in being exists and no maximum causes the being of every other being
paraphrase: Closed control on one three-member interpretation (a top, a maker and a made thing, all in act in esse, ranked strictly; only the maker causes being, and only in the made thing): the idle-maximum rival holds, some being is maximal in being, and no being is both maximal in being and a cause of the being of every other being. A statement about this interpretation only.
